query:
-- Fix PA Governor: Josh Shapiro (D, incumbent) vs Stacy Garrity (R)
-- The AP Engine skip guard fires when both dem_candidate and rep_candidate are non-TBD
-- Austin Davis and Jason Richey are non-TBD so the guard is treating them as locked
-- We need to update AND ensure the skip guard recognizes the correct names
UPDATE governor_races 
SET dem_candidate = 'Josh Shapiro (incumbent)', rep_candidate = 'Stacy Garrity'
WHERE state_code = 'PA';

-- Fix LA Senate: swap candidate1 (D) and candidate2 (R) — they are currently reversed
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Jamie Davis → Gary Crockett (D Runoff, June 16)',
    candidate1_party = 'D',
    candidate2_name = 'Julia Letlow → John Fleming (R Runoff, June 16)',
    candidate2_party = 'R'
WHERE state_code = 'LA';

-- Verify both fixes
SELECT 'GOVERNOR PA' as check_type, dem_candidate, rep_candidate FROM governor_races WHERE state_code = 'PA'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SENATE LA', candidate1_name, candidate2_name FROM senate_races WHERE state_code = 'LA';
